CustomField.description: The bill this charge component belongs to. Master detail, which is what allows Utility_Bill__c.Total_Charges_Amount__c to be a roll up summary rather than an Apex maintained total. FSD 5.10.3.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The utility bill this line is part of. A charge line cannot be moved to another bill, because that would silently change two bill totals and two variance figures at once.
